Parliamentary Monsoon Session to Begin Amidst Opposition Concerns

India's Parliament is set to commence its Monsoon Session on July 20, with the government calling an all-party meeting on July 19. Opposition parties are preparing to raise issues such as the NEET-UG paper leak and remarks made by the Defence Minister. The Chhattisgarh Assembly is also anticipating a busy session with numerous questions scheduled.
